items.title: US strikes Iran in response to downing of military helicopter
items.description: President Donald Trump earlier accused Iran of shooting down the US helicopter over the Strait of Hormuz and vowed to respond.

items.title: Inside Myanmar, rebels are losing ground as military forces men into army
items.description: The BBC travels with rebels to frontline positions in Myanmar to see how the war is unfolding.

items.title: World Cup referee denied US entry arrives home to hero's welcome in Somalia
items.description: Omar Artan vows to officiate at the 2030 tournament instead, following his ban from entering the US.

items.title: Manslaughter charges laid over deadly Hong Kong fire
items.description: The Wang Fuk Court blaze last year was the deadliest that Hong Kong had seen in 70 years, killing 168 people.

items.title: Model who alleges Kanye West choked her tells BBC she felt 'suffocated and scared'
items.description: West claims the encounter on a music video set was part of a "provocative theatrical performance".

items.title: Manhunt under way in South Africa after 12 killed in mass shooting in Johannesburg
items.description: Another nine people were injured at an informal settlement in Cleveland late on Tuesday.

items.title: Pakistan launches deadly air strikes in Afghanistan, reigniting tensions
items.description: The fresh strikes come after weeks of relative calm in the restive border region between the two countries.

items.title: Zelensky under pressure to end row with Poland over WW2 name of army unit
items.description: Poland is threatening to strip Ukraine's president of a state honour over the naming Ukrainian military unit after controversial World War Two fighters.

items.title: Nasa names next astronauts for Artemis Moon programme
items.description: Nasa names its next Artemis crew, though they will not be walking on the Moon or even going anywhere near it.

items.title: Alleged Bondi Beach gunman charged with another 19 offences
items.description: Naveed Akram, 24, is already facing 59 charges over an attack on a Jewish festival in December.

items.title: Man reportedly shot at Kenya protest against US Ebola quarantine centre
items.description: Protesters are concerned about cross-border infection risks and the lack of transparency from the government about the treatment centre.

items.title: Israeli air strikes hit Lebanese city of Tyre despite Iranian warning to stop attacks
items.description: Iran warned Israel on Monday that it could resume hostilities if attacks on its Lebanese ally Hezbollah do not stop.
